title: The Dragon Hunt
description: The time has come. You've prepared, you've planned, and now you face the legendary wyrm dragon. This is no ordinary hunt—this creature is massive, intelligent, and extremely dangerous. But the rewards are legendary: a wyrm dragon pearl, bones for crafting, and the respect of every hunter in the Outer Rim. The hunt begins now.
shortDescription: Hunt and defeat the legendary wyrm dragon

objectives.description: Travel to the wyrm dragon's lair in the Sunder Wastes
Navigate through the dangerous wastes to reach the dragon's lair at the deepest point
Defeat the legendary wyrm dragon in its lair
Recover the wyrm dragon pearl from the defeated dragon
Recover wyrm dragon bones (search the dragon's remains)
